create.name: Harshada Wagner
create.bio:
Harshada Wagner is a meditation teacher, author and artist who has taught for more than thirty years in the Indian mystical traditions of yoga, bhakti, Vedanta and tantra. He first went to India in 1997, received the name Harshada ("one who gives joy") from Gurumayi Chidvilasananda, and has led group pilgrimages there since 2005. He founded Fakiri and guides it as spiritual director; it carries his teaching and publishing and also promotes other teachers and artists who keep South Asian sacred lineages alive.

His approach to meditation is personal and adaptable: rather than one technique for everyone, he helps each student find the practices that connect them with clarity and inner power, and he is known for a relaxed, humorous manner. He teaches through live and self-paced online courses on topics such as kundalini and the subtle body, a six-month Mahayoga practitioner training in mantra, ritual, breath and meditation, one-to-one mentoring over three, six or nine months, and an annual pilgrimage retreat in India devoted to Bhagawan Nityananda. He also writes a regular newsletter.

courses.title: Worlds Within: Mystical Anatomy, Meditation & Yogic Energy Healing
courses.description: A six-week live online course on the subtle body (chakras, nadis, bindus and koshas) with a 40-day guided meditation practice. Classes run on Sunday mornings Pacific time and are recorded.

courses.title: The Yoga of Miracles: India Pilgrimage Retreat 2027
courses.description: A group pilgrimage in India to places linked with Bhagawan Nityananda and to temples of the Goddess, joined with daily practice. Led by Harshada and Ramya LLuvia.

courses.title: Mahāyoga Practitioner Training
courses.description: A six-month advanced programme by application, beginning February 2027, in the teachings and practices of the Mahayoga tradition: meditation, mantra, ritual and breathwork. It is a training for committed practitioners rather than a teacher training.
courses.price: $5,500 prepaid or 8 payments of $750/month; $9,100 prepaid or 8 payments of $1,190/month (Sādhaka level)

courses.title: Private Training with Harshada
courses.description: One-to-one mentoring over three or six months, or a longer nine-month programme with a one-to-one retreat in Ojai. Each container is shaped around the student's practice and life questions.

courses.title: Kundalini Shakti - The Deep Basics
courses.description: A three-week course on kundalini as understood in the Mahayoga tradition, with videos and audio practices. An immersion option adds more depth.

courses.title: 3 Keys to Deep Happiness and Freedom
courses.description: A self-paced course of three video classes with journaling exercises, introducing principles for a freer, purpose-led life on the spiritual path.

courses.title: Practical Spirituality for Challenging Times
courses.description: A seven-part video course on grounding yourself in your core values and virtues and using your practice in everyday life.

free_resources.title: The Bliss of Clarity
free_resources.description: Nine free video sessions that help you clarify your aims on the spiritual path and your reasons for walking it.
